Third-party assets served from this app instead of a CDN, so pages do not depend on (or leak visits to) a third party.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `bulma.min.css` | bulma 0.7.5 | MIT |
| `Chart.min.js` | chart.js 2.8.0 `dist/Chart.min.js` | MIT |
| `ace.js`, `theme-dracula.js`, `mode-*.js` | ace-builds 1.4.6 `src-min-noconflict` | BSD-3-Clause |

Update by downloading the same files from `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/<package>@<version>/...`.
